rubrics.justification: Provides a generally plausible blastocyst description and notes possible partial collapse, ICM and TE assessment, but it over-interprets image details and questions the reported 2AA without strong visual basis; limited discussion of zona/hatching specifics.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, response to stimulation, endometrium, sperm parameters, BMI, smoking, prior IVF history, and diagnosis uncertainty with embryo prognosis.

Reasoning is mostly logical and internally consistent, especially around age-related aneuploidy limiting prognosis despite good morphology; minor issue is some tension between calling the embryo high-quality and repeatedly downgrading the reported AA grade.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: single embryo transfer, avoid unsupported add-ons, smoking cessation, and individualized consideration of PGT-A. Minor deviations include somewhat speculative comments on grading and broad statements about euploid implantation ranges.

Gives clear next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support/monitoring, smoking/alcohol counseling, nutrition, review of embryology course, diagnosis clarification, and when to consider further workup or PGT-A.
